title: The Back gesture did not reach web apps before glasses release 125.1
claim: In June 2026 the official create-webapp skill mapped Back to Escape, and its template app.js navigated back on an Escape keydown.
actual: Before glasses release 125.1, Back never reached the page: the system's web app management screen opened instead, and neither an Escape keydown nor popstate fired. From 125.1, Back (middle finger and thumb tap) calls history.back() when the page has a previous history entry, so it arrives as popstate; with no entry it opens the native overlay. The input and navigation page now describes Back this way and does not mention Escape.
impact: Apps that wait for Escape never see Back. Apps with no history entries cannot intercept it.
workaround: Push a history entry for each screen Back should leave, and handle popstate.

evidence.note: Listened for Escape keydown, as in the template, and for popstate.
Same reporter after updating: Back arrives as popstate.
